summary: Revised development plan for the Checkly Flutter mobile app with self-hosted backend. Updated to reflect actual installed versions (PostgreSQL 18.3, JDK 25, Flutter 3.41.4), confirmed project names (Checkly, not UDAT), and actual project structure (Checkly/ root for Flutter, Checkly/server/ for API).
